## How the score was worked out

Each result implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average, with a small pull toward the middle for thinly tested models. Each test's weight is its *counts* column above; here it is added up by who ran the tests. ## How to run it

### Through an API

api (Alibaba Cloud Model Studio) · $1.10/M blended · $0.4 in / $3.2 out per 1M tokens · [alibabacloud.com](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/models)

<sub>[price source](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/model-pricing): USD per 1M tokens, Singapore (International), qwen3.5-122b-a10b, 0\<Token\<=256K input tier; the same output price applies in thinking and non-thinking mode. China (Beijing) and Global (US Virginia/Frankfurt) deployments are cheaper ($0.115/$0.917 up to 128K) and are not used, following the International convention of other Alibaba rows. Free quota excluded. Observed 2026-09-25. · [context source](https://github.com/anomalyco/models.dev/blob/a668908cfe7073faa0363699486fc41a3ff52412/models/alibaba/qwen3.5-122b-a10b.toml)</sub>

### llama.cpp (recommended)

1. Install llama.cpp. Homebrew and winget installs name the commands llama-cli and llama-server instead. [Other ways to install](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/master/docs/install.md)
   
   ```sh
   # macOS / Linux
   curl -LsSf https://llama.app/install.sh | sh
   # Windows
   irm https://llama.app/install.ps1 | iex
   ```

2. Run Qwen3.5 122B-A10B (Q4_K_M, needs ~74.2 GB, from [huggingface.co/lmstudio-community](https://huggingface.co/lmstudio-community/Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-GGUF/tree/a5ba02062d2fd26c1f17000571ffc86e7abf4c92))
   
   ```sh
   llama cli -hf lmstudio-community/Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-GGUF:Q4_K_M
   ```

3. Or start a local server and open the address it prints (http://localhost:9931)
   
   ```sh
   llama serve -hf lmstudio-community/Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-GGUF:Q4_K_M
   ```

Other versions: Q8_0 (~129.9 GB) `llama cli -hf lmstudio-community/Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-GGUF:Q8_0`

### LM Studio

1. Install LM Studio. Open the app once before using the lms command. [Download it (macOS / Windows / Linux)](https://lmstudio.ai/download)

2. Run Qwen3.5 122B-A10B (Q4_K_M, needs ~74.2 GB, from [huggingface.co/lmstudio-community](https://huggingface.co/lmstudio-community/Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-GGUF/tree/a5ba02062d2fd26c1f17000571ffc86e7abf4c92))
   
   ```sh
   lms get https://huggingface.co/lmstudio-community/Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-GGUF@Q4_K_M -y
   ```

3. Then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name

Other versions: Q8_0 (~129.9 GB) `lms get https://huggingface.co/lmstudio-community/Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-GGUF@Q8_0 -y` · 4bit (~69.6 GB, Mac only) `lms get https://huggingface.co/mlx-community/Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-4bit -y` · 8bit (~130.6 GB, Mac only) `lms get https://huggingface.co/mlx-community/Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-8bit -y`

### Ollama

1. Install Ollama. [Download it (macOS / Windows)](https://ollama.com/download)
   
   ```sh
   # Linux
   curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh
   ```

2. Run Qwen3.5 122B-A10B (Q4_K_M, needs ~75.5 GB, from [ollama.com](https://ollama.com/library/qwen3.5/tags))
   
   ```sh
   ollama run qwen3.5:122b
   ```

### MLX (Mac)

1. Install MLX (Mac). Apple silicon Macs only, text only.
   
   ```sh
   # with uv
   uv tool install mlx-lm
   # or
   pip install mlx-lm
   ```

2. Run Qwen3.5 122B-A10B (4bit, needs ~69.6 GB, Mac only, from [huggingface.co/mlx-community](https://huggingface.co/mlx-community/Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-4bit/tree/e9c67b08899964be5fdd069bb1b4bc8907fe68f5))
   
   ```sh
   mlx_lm.chat --model mlx-community/Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-4bit
   ```

3. Or start an OpenAI-compatible server at http://localhost:8080/v1
   
   ```sh
   mlx_lm.server --model mlx-community/Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-4bit
   ```

Other versions: 8bit (~130.6 GB, Mac only) `mlx_lm.chat --model mlx-community/Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-8bit`

Official weights and documentation: [huggingface.co/Qwen](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.5-122B-A10B)
